name: Thistle
source:
"The castle's oldest member and leader, but not always the most mature.
Believe it or not, the peaceful times you are enjoying are all thanks to his efforts. When needed, he displays great charisma and eloquence, a huge contrast to his silly jokes and somewhat childish hobbies.

As a teacher, he loves to give long historical lessons, and despite what you may think, everyone respects him even if you don’t exactly know why."
